maria_cs: Heads up — prepping the QBR for Nimbus. Finance flagged a potential runway issue driven by embedding-heavy usage. Need: final spend forecast, a short enablement plan for the account, and any product feedback we captured on embeddings costs. Can we triage?

jake_fin: Thanks Maria. Saw a spike on March 2 — estimated extra $18k/mo if usage keeps up. I can send a forecast by EOD. Where's the latest token breakdown?

maria_cs: @jake_fin dashboard link here: https://redwood-internal/dash/nimbus/costs (private) — top-line: embeddings = 62% of token spend last 30d.

nina_pm: Noted. We ran an experiment with 4-bit quant on their embedding model last week. Early results show similar quality but lower latency. @arun_eng can you share the test log?

arun_eng: pasted logs: ```svc/test-run-03-08.log
- model: embed-lite-4bit
- avg latency p95: 120ms -> 85ms
- similarity drift: <0.7% on our eval set
- token cost drop: ~38% per request
```

arun_eng: We need customer opt-in to roll this to prod. There are a couple of edge cases around very long docs where recall dipped — documenting now.

emily_support: Adding customer feedback: they love the vector search speed but called out noisy duplicates when we truncated long docs. They asked for better dedupe and clearer cost reporting.

maria_cs: Good context. For the QBR slide we should present 3 options: 1) Enable quantized embeddings + monitoring (fast, cheaper). 2) Implement prefix-based dedupe and rate cap (safer, medium effort). 3) Conservative: throttles + cost alerts (low effort, higher impact on UX). Thoughts?

laura_cs: I'll draft the enablement plan for option 1 and 2 — include runbook for rollback and request sample prompts from the customer tomorrow.

jake_fin: Forecast plan: I'll model two scenarios — baseline and embedding-optimized. Expect to post numbers by 5pm PT. If quant reduces unit cost ~35% that pushes runway out ~3 months for their current commit.

nina_pm: From product side, we'll prepare a short A/B canary with a 5% rollout. Need CS to coordinate messaging and to collect acceptance signals.

maria_cs: Perfect. Action items: @laura_cs draft enablement + rollback runbook, @jake_fin deliver two-case forecast, @arun_eng finalize edge-case notes and safe-guard toggles, @emily_support gather 3 recent customer quotes on dedupe. I'll assemble QBR slides once those land.

costbot: [automated] Alert created: nimbus-embed-alert-2165550000 — cost spike detected. Slack thread linked.

laura_cs: Will do. ETA EOD tomorrow for the draft.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Quick FYI — include one slide with recommended guardrails and an ask for a short budget uplift for the next quarter to cover the transition. :+1:
